Name: Palico Companion
Author: zzzzzzzhao
Description:
[b]（目前支持简体中文和英文）[/b]

让农场里的猫咪成为陪你探索星露谷的艾露猫伙伴！
它可以陪你进入室内和矿井，在战斗中挥动小剑帮忙，也会在你受到支持的负面效果时赶来救援。
模组沿用原版宠物对象，保留宠物名字、好感度、抚摸、水碗和领养流程。[b]只替换猫，狗和乌龟不受影响。[/b]


通过互动菜单开启跟随，让艾露猫陪你穿过小镇、进入房屋，或一起深入矿井。
伙伴会寻找可通行的路线绕过障碍。跨地图时会跟随进入新区域；确实被地形困住时，会通过带冷却的传送恢复跟随。


跟随状态下进入矿井后，艾露猫会自动寻找附近的怪物，绕过障碍并进行近战攻击。
[list]
[*]基础攻击伤害：[b]5 点[/b]，实际伤害受游戏判定影响。[/*]
[*]攻击间隔：[b]1.5 秒[/b]。[/*]
[*]索敌范围：[b]5 格[/b]。[/*]
[*]最大追击范围：玩家周围 [b]7 格[/b]。[/*]
[*]伙伴没有独立血量，不会死亡。[/*]
[*]怪物击杀与掉落沿用游戏原有流程。[/*]
[/list]玩家受到负面效果时，艾露猫会暂停攻击，靠近玩家并播放救援动作，移除对应效果后恢复行动。
救援依据游戏的负面 Buff 数据判断，第三方模组自定义的控制效果可能不受支持。
[heading]
如何使用[/heading]
[list=1]
[*]正常领养一只猫，已有猫咪的存档也可以使用。[/*]
[*]在农场对猫咪右键互动，第一次由原版抚摸逻辑处理。[/*]
[*][b]短时间内再次右键点击[/b]，打开艾露猫互动菜单。[/*]
[*]选择「跟我一起出门！」开启跟随，或选择「留在农场吧。」停止跟随。[/*]
[/list]跟随会在一天结束时自动停止。
[heading]安装方法[/heading]
需要先安装 [b]SMAPI[/b] 和 [b]Content Patcher[/b]。
将压缩包中的以下两个文件夹放入游戏的
[code]Mods[/code]文件夹，然后通过 SMAPI 启动游戏：
[list]
[*][code]PalicoCompanion[/code][/*]
[*][code][CP] Palico Companion[/code][/*]
[/list]更新时退出游戏，覆盖旧版文件即可。建议在安装或更新模组前备份存档。
当前版本 [b]1.0.5[/b] 已进行连续矿井第 1～5 层跟随、障碍绕行、辅助攻击、击杀掉落和负面状态救援测试。如有新bug可以随时反馈~
[heading]兼容性与注意事项[/heading]
[list]
[*]无需新建存档。[/*]
[*]其他替换猫咪贴图、修改宠物或增加宠物跟随功能的模组可能产生冲突。[/*]
[*]多人联机尚未完成验证，当前建议在单人游戏中使用。[/*]
[*]不包含等级、装备、职业、新商店或剧情系统。[/*]
[/list]



[line]
Let the farm cats become your Eloy cat companions as you explore Stardew Valley!
It can accompany you into indoor areas and mines, swing its small sword to assist you in battle, and come to your rescue when you are affected by negative support effects.
The module retains the original pet objects, including pet names, affection levels, petting, water bowls, and adoption processes. Only cats are replaced, while dogs and turtles remain unaffected.

Activate Follow via the interactive menu, and let Ai Lu Mao accompany you through the town, into the houses, or delve into the mines together.
The companion will seek out navigable routes to bypass obstacles. When crossing maps, it will follow and enter new areas; when indeed trapped by terrain, it will recover its follow by using a cooldown-based teleportation.



After entering the mine in follow mode, Ai Lu Mao will automatically seek out nearby monsters, bypass obstacles, and perform melee attacks.
Base attack damage: 5 points, actual damage is subject to game judgment.
Attack interval: 1.5 seconds.
Detection range: 5 squares.
Maximum pursuit range: 7 squares around the player.
Partners do not have independent health and cannot die.
The killing and looting of monsters follows the original game process.
When the player is affected by a negative effect, Elu the Cat will pause its attack, approach the player and perform a rescue animation, and resume action after removing the corresponding effect.
The rescue is determined based on the game's negative Buff data, and the control effects customized by third-party mods may not be supported.


[b]How to use[/b]

To adopt a cat normally, you can also use an existing cat profile.
Right-click interaction with cats on the farm is handled by the original petting logic for the first time.
Right-click again within a short time to open the interactive menu of Elu Cat.
Choose "Follow me out!" to initiate following, or choose "Stay on the farm." to stop following.
Following will automatically stop at the end of the day.


[b]Installation method[/b]
You need to install SMAPI and Content Patcher first.
Put the following two folders from the zip file into the game's
Mods
Folder, and then start the game via SMAPI:
PalicoCompanion
[CP] Palico Companion
Exit the game during the update and overwrite the old files. It is recommended to back up your save files before installing or updating mods.
The current version 1.0.5 has undergone testing for continuous mine layer 1-5 following, obstacle bypassing, assisted attacks, kill drops, and negative status rescue. If there are any new bugs, please feel free to report them


[b]Compatibility and precautions[/b]
No need to create a new archive.
Other mods that replace cat textures, modify pets, or add pet following functionality may cause conflicts.
Multiplayer online verification is not yet complete. Currently, it is recommended to use it in single-player mode.
It does not include level, equipment, profession, new store, or storyline system.
